title: Comfort

# Comfort

# Introduction

Comfort level determines the duration of Resting Effect. Minimum duration is 8 minutes (at 1 comfort), with each additional comfort level stacking 1 minute up to 24 minutes with usual items and 26 minutes with rare seasonal items.
The max comfort reachable normally is 17. If near a Maypole 18 or with the seasonal Yule tree 19.
When entering most dungeons (such as Burial Chambers), a campfire can be constructed to easily gain Comfort 3 (and a 10-minute Rested effect).
Note that while the player can add more than one furniture item from the categories below, only the one with the highest comfort will influence the comfort rating.

## Comfort level breakdown

Only the highest level item of a category will be used. Items in the same category will not stack with other items in the same category. Items with no category will stack with different items with no category. No item stacks with itself.

• Category: Base Comfort | Items: When sitting near a fireplace. | Comfort: 1 | Notes: These bonuses do not stack with each other.

• Category: While in a shelter near a fireplace[Note 1]. | Items: 2

• Category: Fire | Items: Campfire Bonfire Hanging brazier Standing brazier Blue standing brazier | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Fires do not stack with each other.Only provides comfort when lit.Hearth provides more comfort. Hearth provides the Fire effect at a range of 12m while an extra 1 comfort at a range of 8m.

• Category: Hearth | Items: 2

• Category: Rug | Items: Deer rug Wolf rug Lox rug Hare rug Asksvin rug Straw Bearskin rug Red jute carpet Blue jute carpet | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Rugs do not stack with each other, only one rug will provide a bonus.

• Category: Table | Items: Table Black marble table | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Tables do not stack with each other.Darkwood provides the most comfort.

• Category: Round table Long heavy table | Items: 2

• Category: Chair | Items: Bench Sitting log Stool Black marble bench Ashwood bench | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Chairs do not stack with each other.Any "throne" provides the most comfort.

• Category: Chair Darkwood chair Barber station | Items: 2

• Category: Raven throne Stone throne Black marble throne Bone throne | Items: 3

• Category: Bed | Items: Bed Ashwood bed | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Beds do not stack with each other.Dragon bed provides more comfort.

• Category: Dragon bed | Items: 2

• Category: Banner | Items: Black banner Blue banner White and red striped banner Red banner Green banner Blue, red and white banner White and blue striped banner Yellow banner Purple banner White banner Orange banner | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Banners do not stack with each other.Only actual "banners" provide comfort; some similar-looking structures (e.g. Red jute curtain) do not provide any comfort.

• Items: Hot tub | Comfort: 2 | Notes: Only provides comfort when heated.

• Items: Lava lantern | Comfort: 1

• Items: Armor stand | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Does not need anything being hung on it.

• Items: Maypole | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Can only be built during summer holiday events or with debug mode.Rarely found in Meadows.

• Items: Yule tree | Comfort: 1 | Notes: Can only be built during Yule events or with debug mode.[Note 2] Can be built if you manually change your system date to December 25th.

## Maximum comfort per biome

This table highlights comfort items discoverable within each biome, illustrating the progression of potential comfort levels. Biomes themselves do not directly affect comfort level – only the comfort items placed.
Seasonal items are not included in this table; when they are available, they each add +1 comfort for a potential total bonus of +2 comfort. Both seasonal items are obtainable with Meadows-level gear, but both will require visiting a Black Forest.

• Biome: Meadows | Max comfort level: 5 | Requirements: Campfire | col_3: Bed | col_4: Deer rug

• Biome: Black Forest | Max comfort level: 9 | Requirements: Campfire | col_3: Bed | col_4: Deer rug | col_5: Any Banner | col_6: Chair | col_7: Table

• Biome: Swamp | Max comfort level: 12 | Requirements: Hearth | col_3: Bed | col_4: Deer rug | col_5: Any Banner | col_6: Any Throne | col_7: Table | col_8: Armor stand

• Biome: Mountain | Max comfort level: 13 | Requirements: Hearth | col_3: Dragon bed | col_4: Any Rug | col_5: Any Banner | col_6: Any Throne | col_7: Table | col_8: Armor stand

• Biome: Plains | Max comfort level: 16 | Requirements: Hearth | col_3: Dragon bed | col_4: Any Rug | col_5: Any Banner | col_6: Any Throne | col_7: Round tableor Long heavy table | col_8: Armor stand | col_9: Hot tub

• Biome: Mistlands | Max comfort level: 16 | Requirements: Hearth | col_3: Dragon bed | col_4: Any Rug | col_5: Any Banner | col_6: Any Throne | col_7: Round tableor Long heavy table | col_8: Armor stand | col_9: Hot tub

• Biome: Ashlands | Max comfort level: 17 | Requirements: Hearth | col_3: Dragon bed | col_4: Any Rug | col_5: Any Banner | col_6: Any Throne | col_7: Round tableor Long heavy table | col_8: Armor stand | col_9: Hot tub | col_10: Lava lantern

## Notes

Items must be within ten meters of the character to add comfort.
The following furniture are needed for maximum comfort level:
• 17 comfort (24 minutes): Any throne (3), Dragon bed (2), Any Darkwood table (Round or Long = 2), Hot tub (Heated = 2), Hearth (2), Armor stand (1), Lava lantern (1), any rug (1), any banner (1), and (sheltered = 2).
• 19 comfort (26 minutes): All of the above plus Maypole and Yule tree, which are seasonal items.
Furniture center points:
• Bed, Dragon bed, Hearth: Bottom of the object.
• Bonfire, Campfire: Center of the unlit object.
• Hanging brazier: Top of the object.
• Hot tub: Horizontally slightly towards the chimney, vertically where the chimney starts.
• Yule tree: Almost top of the object.
• Center of the object for everything else.
